hero.eyebrow: Growth Audit · For fintech & SaaS teams
hero.headline: Find the one screen quietly capping your growth.
hero.support: Most funnels don't leak everywhere — they leak in one place. This is a short, expert-eye checklist for finding that one screen or step, built from the same clarity-first lens behind the client work on this site.

problem.situation: You can already see the numbers lagging somewhere in the funnel — sign-up, activation, or conversion — but not exactly where or why.
problem.frustration: The usual response is another dashboard, another A/B test, or a redesign sprint — expensive ways to go looking for a problem that's often just one confusing screen or one badly-worded step.
problem.impact: Every month spent guessing is a month of ad spend and sign-ups quietly leaking out the same door.

solution.headline: Why · What · How
solution.why: In financial products especially, growth problems are almost always clarity problems — one confusing decision point usually costs more than ten missing features.
solution.what: A self-audit checklist covering the funnel, onboarding flow and product copy — the same pattern-recognition used across the fintech, SaaS and training-services work shown on this site.
solution.how: Work through it against your own product and you'll usually spot the highest-leverage fix within the first few sections — no call required to get value from it.
